Amazon to Pump $7 Billion into India's Renewable Energy Sector by 2030
items.snippet: Amazon will invest $7 billion in India’s renewable energy sector by 2030, on top of the $4 billion it has already committed. The investment will back wind, solar and hybrid power projects in Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan, pushing its secured renewable energy capacity above 2 GW.
